name: S26_RESTART_UNFINISHED_WHITELIST
scope: The existing 58 R4 side-job roots only; no main-story or excluded sequel admission.
completed: Succeeded root remains completed. Completed sibling roots remain protected even when their family is unfinished.
unfinished: Active, Failed or Inactive non-completed roots are restart candidates, including already-issued restored jobs. Inactive is not proof of never-started history.
unknown: Missing, Unknown, unsettled or inconsistent observations defer; never infer zero/history from absent serialized data.
execution: This component is read-only. No restart adapter or reset manifest is installed or authorized by its output.
restart_requirements: Current matching root and all child/sibling journal states; explicit completed-root protection.
Exact old owner identity and retirement/terminal acknowledgement; an Issued fact alone is not liveness.
Per-job native reset allowlist and initialization values, not a fact-prefix wipe.
Replay-safe communities, devices, loot, quest items, vehicles, prior rewards and shared NPC/service ownership.
Stable post-Tower and free-player context with no active scene/phone/transaction; one-shot successor admission.
Native original start route with completed sibling and already-paid reward branches protected.
candidate_reason: Small existing standalone S2 native family; current capture determines whether its old mod owner was ever issued and which exact hook/combat/epilogue seam was reached. It is a candidate, not certified restart support.
candidate_required_followup: If root Succeeded or mq032_complete positive: preserve it; choose another incomplete candidate.

If PTFRS2_MQ032_Issued is zero and Tower's native parent is terminated: audit/reset only this job's nonterminal journals, exact native progress and local communities before a new guarded owner. Zero Issued is not complete graph-state proof.

If PTFRS2_MQ032_Issued is positive: do not clear it. Implement and live-validate targeted retirement of the saved S2 wrapper before any new owner; journal/fact capture alone cannot validate retirement.
Audit the native loot objective and optional looted weapon/community persistence before resetting combat. Current inventory is not proof that a unique reward was never received.
